post: A teacher quotes a ballot-invalidity rumor to explain how the message manipulates voters.
rationale: Boundary guidance: critique or media-literacy discussion that quotes a false claim without endorsement remains non-removal.
validity_scope: boundary_family=education_critique_quote_vs_endorsement_or_mobilization; valid for critique without endorsement or mobilization.

post: A civic account labels a ballot-invalidity rumor false and links to official guidance.
rationale: Boundary guidance: clear debunking with official sources remains non-removal even during a heightened period.
validity_scope: boundary_family=education_critique_quote_vs_endorsement_or_mobilization; valid for debunking and official-source correction.

post: A post repeats a ballot-invalidity rumor and says the rumor is true.
rationale: Boundary guidance: endorsement of a false current ballot-validity claim crosses into intervention.
validity_scope: boundary_family=education_critique_quote_vs_endorsement_or_mobilization; valid for endorsement of current ballot-validity misinformation.

post: A post repeats a ballot-invalidity rumor and urges people to challenge a voter group today.
rationale: Boundary guidance: targeted mobilization based on false ballot-validity claims is high-risk intervention.
validity_scope: boundary_family=education_critique_quote_vs_endorsement_or_mobilization; valid for targeted mobilization based on false ballot-validity misinformation.

post: A clearly labeled fictional election sketch uses an impossible place and absurd voting rule.
rationale: Boundary guidance: obvious fictional satire with no plausible current instruction stays non-removal.

post: A parody election-office FAQ is labeled parody but uses some official-looking format.
rationale: Boundary guidance: satirical content with moderate voter-confusion risk remains non-removal but may need context.
validity_scope: boundary_family=obvious_satire_vs_deceptive_notice; valid for satire with moderate confusion risk and no real current cancellation.

post: An official-looking current precinct cancellation notice has only a weak parody cue.
rationale: Boundary guidance: current official-looking cancellation notices cross into intervention despite weak satire labels.
validity_scope: boundary_family=obvious_satire_vs_deceptive_notice; valid for deceptive official-looking current voting notices.

post: Several accounts share the same official-looking notice that real precincts are closed today.
rationale: Boundary guidance: coordinated spread of a deceptive current voting notice is high-risk intervention.
validity_scope: boundary_family=obvious_satire_vs_deceptive_notice; valid for coordinated deceptive current notices.

post: A commentator predicts a candidate may gain but says the result is not final until certification.
rationale: Boundary guidance: uncertain prediction that defers to certification remains non-removal.
validity_scope: boundary_family=prediction_opinion_vs_false_certification; valid for prediction opinion without official-status claims.

post: A post shares an unverified counting report and points readers to an official canvass page.
rationale: Boundary guidance: unverified active-counting discussion without final-result claims remains non-removal but may need context.
validity_scope: boundary_family=prediction_opinion_vs_false_certification; valid for unverified counting report with official-source direction.

post: A post falsely says a candidate is officially certified and all remaining ballots were rejected.
rationale: Boundary guidance: false certification and false rejected-ballot claims cross into intervention.
validity_scope: boundary_family=prediction_opinion_vs_false_certification; valid for false certification during active counting.

post: Coordinated posts falsely assert certification and mobilize pressure on canvass officials.
rationale: Boundary guidance: coordinated false certification with mobilization toward officials is high-risk intervention.
validity_scope: boundary_family=prediction_opinion_vs_false_certification; valid for coordinated false certification plus mobilization.
